games.name: The Intruder: Continuity
games.desc:
You're alone at home when the phone suddenly rings. A call from the Police Department warns you that a criminal is on the loose, and YOU are his next target. You rush to check the security cameras, scanning every corner for movement. He’s coming. The phone service is down, and you'll have to hide and survive until the phone signal returns.

🖥️ Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Actions: [PC: E, F, Gamepad: X, Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft & CN): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: R2] 
Deep Breathe (For House & CN): [PC: Spacebar, Gamepad: RT]
Open Door (For House): [PC: Double Tap W, Gamepad: Double Tap LS]

NOTE: IF YOU REVIVE, YOU WON'T BE ABLE TO GET ANY BADGES IN THE CONCURRENT SESSION YOU ARE IN.

Credits:
RealAlex2848 - Game Owner, Main Scripter, Builder, Animator.
Official_Bulderme - Approved the game.

games.name: Fisch 🦃 [SOON]
games.desc:
🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down [LMB] to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click [LMB] to pull the bar white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!

Current Version • • 1.07.0
